# Arrowhead controls

`control.docx` and `sizes.docx` are original OOXML (generated by tools/arrowheads_fixture.py and a variant
with more sizes) holding floating straight lines whose `a:headEnd`/`a:tailEnd`
use every line-end type (`triangle`, `arrow`, `stealth`, `diamond`, `oval`, §20.1.10.33) at each
`w`/`len` size (§20.1.10.34–35) and 0.5, 1.5 and 6 pt pens. `*-native.pdf` are the reference
application's own PDF exports of them; `reference.json` records the marker geometry read from those
PDFs' vector content, which `tests/arrowheads.test.js` checks the editor's geometry against.
